## Goal

Implement the tokens and primitives from `docs/DESIGN.md` and a homepage prototype for approval (D-005).

## Context

Current UI uses Inter + Barlow via `next/font/google`, ALL CAPS buttons and a TODO brand-colour block in `globals.css`. Primitives exist in `src/components/ui`.

## Scope

- Tokens in `globals.css` `@theme` (colours, radius, spacing, type scale).
- Geist Sans/Mono from the `geist` npm package (self-hosted) replacing `next/font/google` (removes build-time network fetch). Justify the dependency in the PR.
- Restyle existing primitives (Button, Input, Card, States, ResultIndicator), contrast tests for every text token pair in `src/lib/design/contrast.test.ts`.
- Homepage prototype on a preview route or behind the existing page, real data or honest empty state only; screenshots at 375 and 1280 px in the PR.

## Out of scope

- Redesigning other pages (SC-006/007/008).
- Copy changes beyond button casing.
- New component libraries.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Owner approves or rejects the direction in the PR (recorded in D-005).
- [ ] Contrast tests pass for all token pairs used for text.
- [ ] No layout shift from font loading (CLS check on homepage).
- [ ] No mock numbers.

## Required tests

- Standard checks.
- Lighthouse mobile run on `/` (LCP, CLS, accessibility score) pasted.
- Keyboard pass of the homepage.

## Dependencies

- SC-003

## Priority

P1 · Phase A
